description: A choice made with rationale. Use for architectural decisions, hiring choices, product calls — anything where the 'why' matters as much as the 'what' and should survive turnover.

title.description: Short statement of the decision (e.g. 'Use Rust for Core')

rationale.description: Why this decision was made — the load-bearing reasoning

alternatives_considered.description: Other options weighed and why they lost

decided_by.description: Name or entity_id of the decider
